audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart gave Syndra all seven rows while the content layer and the packet both give Azir rows 4, 5 and 6. Three rows already had Azir-winning whys under a Syndra side.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content win[0..6] read Syndra/Syndra/Syndra/Syndra/Azir/Azir/Azir. full phases[].side read Syndra seven times. phases[5].why said 'the soldiers siege towers better than any mid' under a Syndra row.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side, phases[5].side, phases[6].side -> Azir, each why rewritten in the same proposal. Content win[] already correct, so no content chart edit needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text called Unleashed Power 'a flat percent-health execute that threatens to delete you or a soldier' — magnitude with no source, and R targets a champion, not a soldier.
audit.why: Enemy kit R: 'Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres', 675 range, 120/100/80. The execute comes from Transcendent's Splinters of Wrath upgrade, not a flat percentage in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states the 675 range, the all-spheres bombardment, and that the execute arrives with Splinters collected.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range war — the actual decider of this lane — was never stated: Dark Sphere is 800 and Force of Will 925 against Conquering Sands at 740, while Scatter the Weak only reaches 650. Scatter the Weak was also described as a 'cone' that stuns on its own; it stuns only enemies hit by a knocked-back Dark Sphere.
audit.why: Enemy kit Q 800 / 7s, W 925 / 12-8s, E 650 / flat 15s ('Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned'). Owner kit Q 740, W 525, E 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: tldr, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d and report[5].t now carry the real ranges and the sphere-dependency of the stun; breakdown.cooldowns carries the flat 15s E, the 7s Q and the 22s Shifting Sands.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization advised nothing about resistances even though Syndra's upgraded Force of Will deals true damage.
audit.why: missingInteractions key 20, rule resistances-invalidated: Transcendent (P) gives Force of Will (W) bonus true damage, so raw MR is the wrong purchase.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now says raw MR under-delivers because the upgraded W is true damage, and keeps Zhonya's for her R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Syndra is female and the page called her 'he/his' in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, loading, dosFull titles and report[9].t. Separately, dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted verbatim, neither matching its title. dontsFull[1].d quoted 'nineteen seconds' for Shifting Sands, which is rank 3; rank 1 is 22s.
audit.why: champ-gender lists syndra as female. Defect catalogue items 1, 2 and 6. ownerKit E: 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected wherever the sentence was rewritten; bled bullets replaced with bodies that answer their own titles; Shifting Sands quoted at 22s.
